cards.title: Long rooms, at the source
cards.text: No rule ends a long room now. Each cause was found, measured and fixed where it happens. Live as 0.20.1.
cards.why: You said to fix the source, not the symptom. This is what the sources were. One of them was a second hidden clock, which is gone too.
cards.details:
How it was measured: four 150-run campaigns and a 576-run sweep of parties and dungeons, every room timed and sorted by why it ran long.

After the fixes, on the same seeds: the time spent in long rooms is down 37% in the campaigns and 28% in the sweep. A deep room's median went from 134 s to 110 s. Runs that hit the test's 7-minute cut: 16 down to 8.

Still long: a lone hero who can neither win nor lose (the next card); the gilded golem's mirror when it faces the shooter; big enemies in narrow gaps (a major troll is wider than the paths allow for; the real fix is a path grid for big units).

Not taken, measured only: enemy armour grows to its 60% cap deep down. Capping its growth cut the longest Foundry rooms from 19% to 7% but makes the late dungeons easier.

parts.title: A hidden second clock
parts.text: Found in the code: after 45 s without a kill, enemies sped up 30% and stopped mending, regrowing and calling help, and turrets lost 4% health a second. It also reached every boss 45 s in and switched off its adds. Removed, with what it covered for fixed below.

parts.title: The grind (most of it)
parts.text: Over 80% of long-room time was no stand-off: deep enemies' health outgrew the party's damage while a healer kept everyone safe. Deep room enemies now have 7 to 19% less health and hit 4 to 20% harder, so a fight costs about the same in less time. Bosses and mini-bosses are unchanged.

parts.title: Stuck going to a revive
parts.text: A helper could dither for minutes on its way to a downed friend. Traps no longer count as threats, it holds a decision for 2 s, gives up for a while if it gets no closer, and helpers don't swap between two downed friends.

parts.title: Can't reach, can't see
parts.text: A unit that can't get to its target for 6 s picks another. A shooter with no line of sight steps sideways to find one. Fighters wait on a gear's path instead of chasing it.

parts.title: The troll's boulder: a bug
parts.text: The troll never let its boulder go: the roll never fired at all. Fixed. A troll that gets nowhere for 3 s lets it go and fights bare-handed.

parts.title: Enemy healers
parts.text: Heroes go for the enemy that mends the others first. The choir sprite no longer heals itself. Shooters circle to the gilded golem's side instead of firing into its mirror.

parts.title: Boss adds
parts.text: With the clock gone, bosses' adds run the whole fight, which made three much harder. Lightened: the angel's Host every 45 s, the Ooze's Brood three at most, the Wurm's scarabs one at a time and hitting softer. The Wurm is still the hardest: the party wins 15 of 40.

parts.title: The wagon's gate
parts.text: The wagon had the same kind of rule: stragglers at a gate lost health after 70 s. Gone. Now the guards leave their sides and hunt once the wagon has stopped at a gate. 0 stuck trips in 70.

cards.title: A lone hero, no way out
cards.text: The longest rooms left: one hero alone who can't kill what's left and can't die, like a Cleric against gears.
cards.why: Nothing is broken here; the hero just can't finish it. Any fix is a new rule, so it's your call. Today the player can tap Leave.

options.label: Leave it: the player taps Leave
The hero gives up and walks out
